basis: Retinal, hearing and skeletal abnormalities define syndrome; brain atrophy 2/3. Hypertension, hypothyroidism and sparse hair (2/3 each) omitted at cap.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: defining short stature is accompanied by brachydactyly and broad thumbs in 3/3, establishing a core skeletal phenotype.

basis: Cardiac and skeletal defects define Noonan syndrome; hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 80-99%, developmental delay 30-79%. Platelet dysfunction (30-79%) omitted at cap.

decisions.haematologic: none: platelet dysfunction qualifies at 30-79%, but is omitted at the four-axis cap in favor of endocrine dysfunction and neurodevelopmental impairment.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: supplied HPO reports hypogonadotropic hypogonadism in 80-99%, supporting common endocrine loss of function.

basis: PRC2-related overgrowth spectrum combines developmental/intellectual impairment with characteristic skeletal overgrowth and advanced bone maturation.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: skeletal overgrowth and advanced bone maturation characterize PRC2-related overgrowth syndromes; this is a defining skeletal phenotype.

basis: Inherited loss of NTCP-mediated hepatic bile-acid uptake; osteopenia in 3/8 (~38%) supports skeletal involvement.

decisions.hepatic: primary: the defining transport defect is loss of hepatic bile-acid uptake; primary location does not require additional evidence of hepatocellular injury.

basis: Neurodevelopmental and GI dysfunction define syndrome; skeletal abnormalities include hyperlordosis in 7/10; strabismus 7/14 and hypermetropia 5/14 support ocular involvement.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: hyperlordosis in 7/10 (70%), with small hands/feet in ~90%, establishes common structural skeletal involvement.

basis: Goniodysgenesis and intellectual disability define syndrome; tricuspid regurgitation occurs in 30-79%. Respiratory insufficiency lacks an established direct pulmonary cause.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory insufficiency is reported in 30-79%, but no direct lung or airway disorder is established; prematurity is also reported.

basis: Neurodevelopmental and hallmark cutaneous abnormalities define PKS; visual impairment 17/22; skeletal delay/hypermobility 80-99%. Delayed dentition omitted at cap.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: characteristic pigmentary mosaicism and temporal alopecia are hallmark diagnostic features; supplied hair and sweat abnormalities occur in 80-99%.

basis: Skeletal growth disorder with rhizomelia 3/6; hypothyroidism 3/4, cardiac defects 2/5 and hearing impairment 2/5. Epidermoid cysts 2/5 omitted at cap; mild ID 1/4.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: hypothyroidism in 3/4 (75%) supports common syndromic endocrine dysfunction, but does not define this chromosomal instability syndrome.

basis: Clonal lymphoid malignancy arising in lung parenchyma or bronchi; lymphoma requires the immune axis and malignant blood-cell lineage supports the haematologic axis.

decisions.haematologic: primary: lymphoma is a malignancy of lymphoid blood cells, including when its primary anatomical site is extranodal.

basis: Primary vascular neoplasm of splenic red-pulp sinus lining establishes splenic and vascular origins; immunological associations do not establish immune-mediated disease.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: this is explicitly a vascular neoplasm arising from cells lining splenic blood sinuses, establishing vascular origin.
